meaning:
δυνατέω, -ῶ
(δυνατός),
to be able, be powerful, mighty: with inf., Rom.14:4, 2Co.9:8; absol., opposite to ἀσθενῶ 2Co.13:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
